# R406 — numerical qualification and capture for restored layer-major prefill

Date: 2026-10-13 Asia/Tokyo. Read-only source/evidence audit for the restored layer-major path and first-row capture. No source edits, builds, tests, lint, profiler, GPU/model/service/process work, cleanup, or Git mutation. Sole write: this report. It does not repeat R405 ownership review. Current-source inspection was limited to the named dirty worktrees and reports; no secret record or broad private-environment scan was read.

## Finding

The existing capture qualification proves that the gated producer can publish one finite FP32 vocabulary row for a fresh request at position `P-1`, effective prefill `T=1`, then emit one token and complete normally. In the 1024 and 32768 requests on the recorded B machine, captured-row argmax equaled that request's emitted token. This is a producer/lifecycle check only. It does not compare candidate logits with a baseline distribution, score more than the single emitted history row, establish held-out NLL/perplexity, cover 262144 physical cells, RESTORE, or qualify layer-major numerics. The coincidence of one captured row's argmax and the model's own sampled/emitted token is self-consistency, not intercandidate quality evidence.

The fixed-history comparator implementation can enforce a sound paired comparison, but its `REVIEWED_PRODUCERS` table is empty and the serve capture is not registered. Its current adapter accepts a specific standalone native segmented dump producer and verifies provenance, exact prompt/follow IDs, row geometry, finite full-vocabulary files, source/binary/runtime identities, successful owner exit/reap and closed capture, then compares target log probability/NLL, top-1/top-2, rank and margin. It deliberately requires at least two rows for a production comparison. The current serve producer is single-row `max_new=1`; the helper's synthetic CPU fixtures and schema checks are not a reviewed production adapter. No quality flag is currently true.

## Precise missing inputs for controlled comparison

Before adapter registration, a reviewable comparison unit needs all of the following, with baseline and candidate bound to the same values:

1. A held-out, fixed prompt token list and a fixed follow/target token list of at least two tokens; token IDs, hashes, tokenizer identity, model/provider identity, `P`, `N`, `max_context`, position convention `P-1+i predicts follow[i]`, BOS/EOS and scoring mask. Include prompts that exercise representative short/long content and the layer-major boundary classes. Do not use generated continuation equality as the label or acceptance criterion.
2. Separate baseline and layer-major captures of every FP32 vocabulary row for those same `N` teacher-forced follow positions, through the actual production verifier/head at stride 1. Each capture must have the exact header/byte count, all 248320 logits per row for this model, finite values, matching hashes, and a closed/reaped normal process receipt with fault checks. The existing `max_new=1` first-row opt-in cannot produce this dataset as-is; an authorized capture path must accept fixed target histories and retain complete rows without changing sampling or request output semantics.
3. Pins for each arm's binary, source tree/patch identity, runtime/provider and relevant configuration, plus a receipt tying those hashes and exact token files to the closed capture. Record actual effective prefill `T`, raw `--spec` capacity, `max_new`, chunk size, KV mode, context length and all numeric-affecting feature/environment flags separately. For clean attribution, use identical settings and inputs on both arms; only the layer-major route should differ.
4. A reviewed production adapter registration that authenticates the actual serve producer's semantics and lifecycle evidence against the comparator schema. The current adapter's hardcoded standalone-native provider check cannot attest the serve producer by assumption. Register only after source review and a real controlled capture; then make the comparison manifest reference that producer and explicit consumer/retirement point.
5. A preregistered held-out set and acceptance policy: aggregate and per-row target NLL/log-probability deltas, top-1/top-2/rank/margin, plus any required distribution-distance statistic; define tolerances before looking at candidate results. A passing single argmax or identical generated string is insufficient.

The minimum first adapter exercise is `N>=2`, full vocabulary, one modest context where both arms are already qualified, then identical token histories through ordinary chunk-major and restored layer-major. Expand to longer held-out histories and the 262144 boundary only after the small paired dataset passes and its receipt is accepted. Preserve individual failures and statuses.

## Source constraints and numerical invariants to compare

Current `run_layer_major` is a fresh full-model single-GPU request path: it rejects nonzero `pos0`/checkpoint state through the fresh PLE/session checks, borrowed workspace, phase cache, stage callbacks, embedding-row input, split/pipeline/helper paths and unsupported KV staging modes. It computes each model layer across chunks and hands its residual rows to the next layer. Current generate admission also rejects layer-major combined with `--full-context-probe`; the full-context probe separately has a strict exact-extent, MTP, no-serve contract. Current layer-major source explicitly rejects checkpoint/RESTORE and resumed prefill. Therefore neither full-context-probe plus layer-major nor RESTORE is qualified by the 32K gated capture.

The comparison must preserve/inspect these numeric state contracts at every layer boundary, not merely final text:

- PLE: save the original `ple_prev` pair once for the entire request; layer 0 must not publish the prompt's final pair before layer 1 gathers initial PLE rows. Reset PLE history exactly as the qualified fresh-request route does. Compare PLE rows/history and `ple_prev` after the prompt.
- QSA/streamed KV: preserve per-QSA indexer state in ascending absolute-position order; seed the full host prefix into the identity stage for each chunk, append the current chunk to canonical host KV/resident slots/stage, then select/attend before reuse. Include the final partial chunk and partial KV page. Compare KV codes/scales, page map/slot content, indexer counters/tail/dead/block positions and selected IDs. Do not infer that resident capacity 32768 limits the host-authoritative staged context.
- GDN and residual handoff: compare recurrent and convolution state, exact incoming/outgoing residual rows, and the final head logits. The layer-major FP32 residual bridge and changed execution order can expose state/rounding defects even where each local kernel is unchanged.
- Interlayer norm/cvec fusion: record the exact fusion flag and compiled route on both arms. The source has separate write/cvec/norm and fused write+cvec+next-norm routes; their reduction/rounding order can affect output. A baseline with fusion enabled against a layer-major arm with it disabled is not a controlled comparison. If both routes are tested, treat them as separate, paired arms and record each result rather than folding the differences into one layer-major claim.
- Keep the model GGUF, packed weights, tokenizer, native expert profile/cache, head/provider, device/runtime/driver, build/compiler flags, `STRATA_CVEC_FUSE`, chunk size (canonical 8192 for the existing measured recipe), `STRATA_SERVE_FIRST_ROW_CAPTURE`, and effective `T` identical where applicable. Keep `raw --spec=4` for the existing Verifier geometry and record actual effective `T=1` for first-row cases; raw capacity is not effective token count. Disable MTP, suffix draft, lookup, adaptation and batching for the capture path unless the same exact route is intentionally qualified on both sides.

## Full physical extent and RESTORE qualification

The full-context target is physical `max_cells=262144`: test spans that end immediately below, exactly at, and one beyond the boundary, with explicit checks for `pos0+n` overflow-safe rejection. Include the final partial 8192-token chunk and page tails 1/2/3, and capture the complete vocabulary row at position 262143 when the request has filled positions 0 through 262143. A separate follow-on one-token GEN at position 262143 is only valid when its prefix count/state gives that token the last physical slot; do not confuse it with a request that already consumed all 262144 cells, where a subsequent KV write would exceed capacity. Record the exact position convention for every row and next-token action.

No evidence currently proves full exhaustion under layer-major, finite logits at the last cell, successful following decode at the last legal position, or memory admission under full bridge/cache/head/workspace use. First run the same exact prompt and configuration through the established chunk-major reference and candidate; compare per-layer boundary state and final row. Repeat with `pos0=0` full prefix and near-boundary lengths. RESTORE is a separate feature gate: current route rejects it, so first design/implement explicit checkpoint save/restore semantics for residual bridge cursor, PLE pair/history, every GDN state, QSA host KV/indexer state, position/capacity and any partial page; then test save-before-boundary, save at final partial chunk, restore, and continue. Compare restored continuation logits against uninterrupted chunk-major and uninterrupted layer-major under fixed token histories. No RESTORE pass may be inferred until this state is serialized/restored and paired numerically.

## Minimal actionable source/test plan (proposal only)

1. Add a bounded fixed-history capture mode to the existing successful phase-gated producer (or a separate strictly gated producer) that accepts a pinned prompt plus follow IDs, emits one full FP32 vocabulary row at each `P-1+i` under `T=1` fixed-history conditioning, and retains the existing checked copy, finite check, normal completion and close/reap receipt. Keep its default OFF and make the source/binary/config capture identity explicit. Add a reviewed adapter mapping this producer's real command, token files, row files, provider, environment and owner receipt to `fixed-history-capture-receipt.v1`; keep production/quality flags false until a real row set is compared and reviewed.
2. Create a paired baseline/candidate manifest using the same tokenizer/model/input hashes, positions, target IDs, context, capture geometry, binary/runtime provenance, and numeric settings. First use `N>=2` at an ordinary qualified context; run comparator on those captures and record deltas/acceptance. Extend the held-out set only after that round is complete.
3. Add a narrowly scoped CPU fixture for adapter schema mapping/negative mismatches and comparator consumption. It verifies artifact identity and rejection behavior; it cannot stand in for GPU numerical evidence. For source algorithm checks, add/use a host/device parity harness that compares layer-boundary state snapshots between chunk-major and layer-major on small controlled lengths, including PLE entry reset, streamed QSA stage refresh, GDN state, fusion setting, chunk-final partial and fault/cleanup outcomes.
4. With Main's serialized hardware slot, execute exact full 262144 physical span and near-boundary cases against the chunk-major baseline with the same full model/config. Collect full finite rows at needed positions and per-state diagnostics. Separately exercise last-legal GEN. If allocation/admission fails, preserve refusal status; do not shrink reserve/config silently. Any timing comparison remains the unchanged upstream `bench.sh --long --runs3` process only; no new GEN speed comparison is proposed.
5. Keep RESTORE disabled until its state contract is implemented, then do uninterrupted-vs-restored fixed-history comparisons at early, partial-page, partial-chunk, and near-capacity checkpoints. Save hashes and state/layout evidence; test final/partial cancellation and no-read-after-release lifecycle separately from numeric acceptance.

The capture report records B570 10 GiB / Ryzen 5600X / 128 GiB RAM and fresh 1024/32768 requests, 8192 chunks, finite FP32 rows for vocabulary 248320 at `P-1`, actual `T=1`, reuse zero, one emitted token, normal close, and row argmax equal to emitted ID. It explicitly excludes fixed-history distribution equality, NLL/full quality, full physical context, RESTORE and speed. The fixed-history review reports passing CPU schema/negative tests and an empty real producer registry; its production and quality flags remain false. All source/test/device plans above are proposed, unexecuted work.

## Explicit untested limits

No comparison capture or source/test changes were made here. There is no reviewed serve producer adapter, paired baseline/candidate distribution report, held-out NLL, layer-boundary runtime equality, 262144-cell exhaustion, last-legal follow-on GEN, layer-major full-context-probe support, RESTORE support, or layer-major quality/speed pass. The prior capture's self-argmax fact does not establish quality.
